parameters.query:
SELECT
    request_id,
    created_date,
    permalink,
    kind,
    topic,
    domains,
    confidence_claimed,
    confidence_key,
    confidence_downgraded,
    articles_read,
    dd_count,
    router_error,
    parse_error,
    prompt_version,
    draft_useful,
    feedback_text
FROM dl.usr_cross_data.support_request
WHERE feedback_text IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY created_at DESC
